breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: Dirichlet on all four edges and periodic. The ground truth resolved this by removing the periodic condition. The agent correctly identified this conflict and generated a specification that uses only the Dirichlet conditions, explicitly stating 'Do not apply periodic boundary conditions', which aligns perfectly with the ground truth's correction.
